section.title: General repair policy
section.para: Repairs under this module are limited to forward-fuselage structure and structural provisions owned by PBS-10-10-10. Do not absorb system ownership from lightning protection, weather radar, cooling, or landing-gear branches.
Any repair affecting geometry, certification basis, RF transparency, or lightning path integrity requires coordinated re-verification before acceptance.

section.title: Known coupled repair case at baseline
section.para: Radome repairs are jointly constrained by RF transmission/boresight performance, bird-strike resistance, lightning Zone 1A behavior, rain erosion, and moisture-ingress control.
Pressure-boundary and barrel repairs must preserve structural continuity and the controlled splice to the centre section.

warning.para: TBD: Approved repair schemata, material callouts, and allowable damage envelopes are not present in the current SSOT set. This module therefore defines only governing repair constraints at baseline.
